page.overview:
Who is LeClerc?

LeClerc was a mercenary who worked as a co-pilot and deckhand aboard the Essex. He and the rest of the crew were contracted by Martin Krebs to travel to Ile Saint-Hubert and collect DNA samples from the largest prehistoric species there in order to create a cure for heart disease. LeClerc is Haitian and primarily speaks French.

LeClerc co-piloted the Essex alongside Nina, whom he shared a close bond with. On their way to the Mosasaurus location, the ship picked up a mayday signal from Reuben Delgado. He and his family were stranded at sea after the Mosasaurus attacked their sailboat La Mariposa. After some debate, Kincaid decides that they would go to the provided coordinates to rescue them. Later on, LeClerc and Nina spot the overturned vessel from the upper pilothouse and Reuben fires a flare gun into the air. They steer the ship to where he is so that he, Isabella Delgado, Teresa Delgado, and Xavier Dobbs can all board it. After this, the team continues tracking the Mosasaurus.

During the encounter with the Mosasaurus to get DNA from it, LeClerc stayed inside the ship with Bobby Atwater and the Delgados. After the sample was successfully acquired, he congratulates Henry for his success.

The Mosasaurus would later return with a group of Spinosaurus to attack the Essex. Atwater tries fending off the Spinosaurs, but is surprise attacked by one and taken away. Duncan begins piloting the ship and tells LeClerc the engine is overheating. He goes down to the engine room to try quelling the heat. Now that the ship was close to shore, the Mosasaurus and its associates stopped pursuing it. LeClerc and Duncan were the only two who did not jump off before the boat crashed on the rocks of the island.
